reason: Alert-TP: User-controlled input flows from request.getParameter('BlCurated00081') to param, then to baz (line 34), and finally to the HTML sink on line 36. The sink writes baz directly into JavaScript without htmlEscape(), while bar holds the escaped version. This is a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input flows to param, then to unescaped baz, which is written to response without sanitization
